## AC5 LIVE VALIDATION — MET (operator-authorized edge deploy, 2026-09-01)

**Provenance:** environment = deployed edge https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com (EC2 i-00880b2c7f13527c5, us-east-1). HTTP probes = anonymous public client, no credential transmitted. On-box actions via `aws ssm send-command` as the operator's AWS identity (arn:...:user/joe_frontier), operator-authorized.

**Deploy performed (the only remaining step):** the merged fix (change 2348 / commit 25fd2cf6dd75) was present in the box mirror (`/var/lib/rebar/mirror`, origin/main) but the running `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` was the pre-fix 2026-08-27 render. Rendered the template with the documented restricted `envsubst '${REVIEW_BOT_PORT}'` (REVIEW_BOT_PORT=8000), backed up the old conf to `rebar.conf.bak-a61d-20260901T175436Z`, `nginx -t` PASS, `systemctl reload nginx` OK. Verified nginx runtime vars survived ($host count 27, zero leftover `${`), all three per-location backstops rendered (review 8000 / opcert 8090 / gerrit 8080). Note: the container root-cause layer was ALREADY live — both `compose-review-bot-1` and `compose-opcert-1` already carry `FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS=*` (recreated post-fix), so uvicorn already emitted https; the nginx render adds the committed proxy_redirect backstop.

**Live probes (external, over HTTPS, unauthenticated), actual headers:**
```
GET /review/health/   -> HTTP/2 307   location: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/health
GET /review/webhook/  -> HTTP/2 307   location: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/webhook
GET /review/rerun/    -> HTTP/2 307   location: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/rerun
GET /opcert/health/   -> HTTP/2 403   (no Location; structural fail-closed guard)
```
http_downgrade_count = 0 across all four surfaces (the AC5 rule: no `http://` Location).

**Blast-radius check (box also hosts the live fail-closed Gerrit submit gate):** clean — `GET /` (Gerrit) -> HTTP 200; `GET /mcp/` -> HTTP/2 401 (auth-gated, healthy). No container was restarted; only a graceful host `nginx -s reload`. review-bot `/health` reported `in_flight:0` before the reload.

**Attribution:** plan_defect. Per the merged commit, this is 79b2's root cause (b) — `FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS` was configured only for the mcp service, so uvicorn's ProxyHeadersMiddleware trusted only 127.0.0.1 for review-bot and opcert; nginx arrives from the docker bridge gateway, `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` was dropped, and Starlette's trailing-slash 307 built an `http://` Location. The sibling services were set up without the proxy-headers trust that 79b2 established for mcp. Fixed on both layers (container trust + per-location nginx backstop).
